questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: The semilunar valve that prevents backflow of blood into the right ventricle is the:
questions.explanation: The pulmonary valve guards the outflow of the right ventricle.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Anatomy

questions.question: Precordial lead V6 is placed at the:

options.A: 4th intercostal space at the left sternal border
options.B: Mid-axillary line at the level of V4
options.C: Anterior axillary line at V4 level
options.D: 5th intercostal space in the mid-clavicular line

questions.explanation: V6 is in the mid-axillary line at the level of V4 and V5.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: The association between exposure and outcome is studied in:
questions.explanation: Analytic studies (cohort, case-control) test hypotheses about exposure and outcome.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: The angle of incidence for the electromagnetic rays to have maximum absorption should be:
questions.explanation: Maximum absorption occurs when rays strike the surface at 90 degrees.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: Deficiency of which vitamin causes peripheral neuropathy, depression and convulsions?
questions.explanation: Vitamin B6 is needed for neurotransmitter synthesis.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Medicine

questions.question: Precordial lead V2 is placed at the:

options.A: 4th intercostal space at the left sternal border
options.B: 5th intercostal space at the mid-clavicular line
options.D: 4th intercostal space at the right sternal border

questions.explanation: V2 is left of the sternum in the 4th intercostal space.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: When the subjects are not aware of the research hypothesis, the study is:
questions.explanation: Single blinding masks only the participants.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: On the 0 to 4+ reflex scale, a very brisk reflex with clonus is graded:
questions.explanation: 4+ is hyperactive with sustained clonus.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: For ordinal data, which measure of central tendency is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: The median does not require equal intervals.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: For an adult, a cadence of ______ steps per minute is considered normal.
questions.explanation: Average adult cadence is about 100-120 steps per minute.

questions.question: A lumbar puncture is performed at or below the level of:
questions.explanation: A needle is placed below the conus medullaris, usually in the L3-L4 or L4-L5 interspace.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: Type A personality (competitive, time-urgent, hostile) is associated with an increased risk of:
questions.explanation: Hostility is the most toxic component.
questions.sourceBook: Morgan & King, Introduction to Psychology (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Psychology

questions.question: A therapist palpates the bony structures of the wrist and hand. Which of the following structures would not be identified in the distal row of carpals?
questions.explanation: The triquetrum is in the proximal row; capitate, hamate and trapezoid are distal.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 252
questions.subject: Anatomy

questions.question: Lack of insight in psychotic disorders refers to:

options.D: Failure to recognise that one is ill

questions.explanation: Assessed as part of the mental state examination.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Psychiatry

questions.question: Not associated with osteogenesis imperfecta is:
questions.explanation: Osteogenesis imperfecta features blue sclerae, deafness and fractures; cataract is not typical.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: Following a zone of infarction in the myocardium, the ECG change seen is:
questions.explanation: Infarcted myocardium is electrically dead, giving Q waves.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: Wilson's disease is ___________.

options.B: Caused by disturbance of copper metabolism

questions.explanation: Wilson disease is an inherited disorder of copper metabolism causing hepatolenticular degeneration.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Pathology & Microbiology

questions.question: For an adult healthy male, the normal range of body fat is about:
questions.explanation: Healthy adult male body fat is roughly 12-20 percent.

questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: Krukenberg's amputation is done for problems of which of the following?
questions.explanation: Krukenberg's operation converts the forearm stump into a pincer in bilateral hand loss.

questions.question: On the EMG loudspeaker, fibrillation potentials sound like:

options.A: A diver bomber or machine gun
options.D: Rain drops on a roof top

questions.explanation: Fibrillations give a regular, high-pitched crackling sound like rain on a tin roof.

questions.question: In which phase is the only point of contact between the ground and the stance limb the toes?
questions.explanation: At toe off only the toe is in contact with the ground before swing starts.
